'''Nkonya''' is a [[Guang language]] spoken by the people of [[Nkonya]] in the [[Biakoye District]] of the [[Oti Region]] of [[Ghana]]. A phonology<ref>{{cite web|last=Peacock|first=Wesley|title=Nkonya phonology|url=https://nkonya.webonary.org/files/Nkonya_Phonology_FINAL.pdf|access-date=2019-04-02|archive-date=2023-01-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230128052531/https://nkonya.webonary.org/files/Nkonya_Phonology_FINAL.pdf|url-status=dead}}, Institute of African Studies, University of Ghana, 2007</ref> and a dictionary are available.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nkonya dictionary|url=https://webonary.org/nkonya}}, 2018 GILLBT</ref>
